features.name: Connect & extract schema
features.description: Connect directly to a live database and pull every table, view, column, key, and relationship into a navigable map.
features.notes: Supports SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, and SQLite from one UI.

features.name: Visual schema browser
features.description: A single-page HTML browser of the whole database: searchable table list with columns, types, and primary keys.
features.notes: Served locally at http://localhost:9876.

features.name: Relationship views (FK-in / FK-out / diagram)
features.description: See what each table points to, what points back at it, and a relationship diagram of the neighbourhood.
features.notes: Works even when the database declares no formal foreign keys.

features.name: Inferred relationships for FK-less schemas
features.description: MapSnap discovers likely joins from naming and config so OnBase-style schemas stop looking like disconnected islands.
features.notes: Critical for OnBase, where relationships are enforced in the application layer.

features.name: Module / system grouping
features.description: Tables are grouped by the enterprise system and module they belong to for easier navigation.
features.notes: Auto-detected via table-name signatures (OnBase, Jenzabar, PeopleSoft, Banner, SAP, Epic, Blackbaud, Dynamics 365).

features.name: Schema compare / diff
features.description: Compare two profiles or two snapshots to see what tables and columns were added, removed, or changed.
features.notes: Useful for tracking schema drift between environments or vendor upgrades.

features.name: Chat with your schema
features.description: Ask plain-English questions about the database and get answers grounded in the actual schema and its enrichment.
features.notes: Runs on a local Ollama model by default; no data leaves the machine.

features.name: Natural-language to SQL
features.description: Type a question; MapSnap drafts the SQL, you review it, and run it read-only against the live database.
features.notes: Generation is live; results render locally only.

features.name: Local SQL execution with results
features.description: Run the generated (or hand-written) read-only query and view results inside the app.
features.notes: A read-only guard rejects writes; row caps are enforced.

features.name: Verified-query library
features.description: Successful queries are remembered and offered as worked examples, so the assistant gets better at each database over time.
features.notes: Code shipped; goes fully live after the pending elevated service restart.

features.name: Frontier (cloud) model option
features.description: Optionally route the assistant to a top-tier cloud model for stronger reasoning, gated by the profile's data policy.
features.notes: Mechanism is live; enabling it for regulated data needs the institution's DPA/BAA and a raised policy.

features.name: Local-only by default
features.description: Out of the box nothing leaves the machine — neither data nor schema — so the compliant posture is the default, not an afterthought.
features.notes: FERPA / GLBA / HIPAA-aware; fail-safe for any unset policy.

features.name: Per-profile data policy
features.description: Each database can be set to local_only, cloud_metadata_only, or cloud_with_agreement to control exactly what may reach a cloud model.
features.notes: Enforced server-side at a single egress chokepoint.

features.name: Automatic PII detection & masking
features.description: Profiling flags columns that look like SSNs, emails, phones, names, or account numbers and masks their sample values.
features.notes: Profiling pass shipped; live after the pending elevated service restart.

features.name: Egress audit log
features.description: Every cloud-bound call is logged with what was sent and why, so compliance can prove regulated data did not leave.
features.notes: Written to the MapSnap log; level configurable.

features.name: Profile lock
features.description: A profile carrying regulated columns can be locked so raising its policy requires an admin and a recorded agreement.
features.notes: Prevents casual downgrade of the compliance posture.

features.name: CSV schema import
features.description: When direct connection is blocked, export catalog queries to CSV and import them to build the same map.
features.notes: Auto-detects Objects / Columns / Primary Keys / Foreign Keys CSV roles by header.

features.name: DDL schema import
features.description: Build a schema directly from a CREATE TABLE / DDL export when no live connection is available.
features.notes: Handy for offline or air-gapped reviews.

features.name: OnBase config import
features.description: Import OnBase .expk / .spk Studio packages to extract DocType and keyword definitions into a business-value catalog.
features.notes: Turns 'checks' into the real DocType 'Check Image'.

features.name: Document library with RAG search
features.description: Drop reference documents beside a schema; MapSnap indexes them so the assistant can cite them.
features.notes: Supports txt / md / csv / docx / pdf / xml / json / OnBase packages.

features.name: Add reference content by URL
features.description: Attach a web page or document URL to a profile's knowledge base.
features.notes: Fetched and indexed alongside uploaded documents.

features.name: Login authentication
features.description: Real user accounts with hashed passwords and session tokens for shipped / customer deployments.
features.notes: A first-run admin is seeded and forced to change its password.

features.name: Roles & per-tab permissions
features.description: Viewer, contributor, builder, analyst, and admin roles control which tabs and features each user sees.
features.notes: Per-user overrides can only narrow a role's permissions.

features.name: Multi-profile management
features.description: Manage many database profiles side by side and switch the active one without restarting.
features.notes: Each profile keeps its own schema, sidecars, and connection.

features.name: AI Connections settings
features.description: Configure local Ollama models, OpenRouter, and direct cloud providers in one panel.
features.notes: Cloud options are greyed out for local_only profiles.

features.name: Remote access via secure tunnel
features.description: Reach the local MapSnap UI from anywhere over a stable, named Cloudflare tunnel.
features.notes: mapsnap.quiddityinnovations.com, managed centrally by QI Hive.

features.name: Schema confirmation report
features.description: Generate a Word report confirming the extracted schema, counts, and relationships for stakeholder sign-off.
features.notes: Produced via the docs generators (python-docx).

features.name: Admin guide & feature list
features.description: Maintained operator documentation covering setup, AI connections, and the full feature catalogue.
features.notes: Lives under C:\APPS\MapSnap\docs as .docx files.

features.name: Runs as a managed Windows service
features.description: MapSnap and its tunnel run unattended as QI_MapSnap and QI_MapSnapTunnel NSSM services.
features.notes: Auto-start, log rotation, and central registry entry.

features.name: Auto-enrichment on build
features.description: Extract, document import, and config import automatically trigger the enrichment chain so schemas are born understood.
features.notes: Orchestrator wired; the live profiling/embedding layers activate after the pending restart.
